text:
Ethan R.: FYI — we received a retrofit invoice from PartnerLayer for reserved Dedicated capacity that used the legacy ratecard (v1.2) instead of the effective v1.5 pricing. Invoice: PL-RSV-20260430-77, gross = 64,320 USD. Looks like the downstream billing transform didn't pick up the ratecard update.
Priya K.: Oof. Does this hit recognized revenue for April or is it still in deferred?
Ethan R.: The invoice applied to monthly recognition schedule — system already accelerated revenue for Apr on that line because the invoice landed in billing-run-2.
Dana L.: Materiality check: 64.3k > our 50k threshold. This requires review and potentially a restatement/adjusting journal in the period.
CustomerOpsBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-RSV-179101 (PartnerLayer ratecard mismatch invoice PL-RSV-20260430-77)
Lina T.: If we post a reversing entry and re-recognize using corrected amount, auditors will want: ticket, vendor confirmation, spreadsheet with invoice id/customer id/plan, and timing of recognition.
Alex M.: Eng found root cause: config propagation to the transform cluster failed 2026-04-29 22:40 UTC; hotfix pushed. We'll reprocess the invoice feed and emit a corrected invoice row; ETA 6 hrs.
Priya K.: Proposed accounting treatment: post an adjusting journal for April close to defer the overstated recognized revenue and move into Deferred Revenue pending re-import. Journal (USD):
DR Recognized Revenue (4001) 64,320
CR Deferred Revenue (2100) 64,320
Memo: "Adjusting JE for PartnerLayer ratecard mismatch invoice PL-RSV-20260430-77; pending corrected import."
Dana L.: Approve posting per policy given materiality, provided we attach the vendor email confirming corrected billing and the re-import logs. We'll treat as an adjusting entry in Apr close and reverse once corrected record posts.
Ethan R.: I'll create the reconciliation spreadsheet with line-level details and link to ticket FIN-RSV-179101.
Alex M.: Once re-run completes I'll attach the transform log + file checksum and mark the ticket resolved. Ops will run the reprocess in dry-run first and send logs to finance.
Lina T.: Remember FX impact if vendor re-invoices in EUR — include fx rate used on the date of original recognition and the corrected posting.
Priya K.: Noted. Timeline: spreadsheet + JE package by EOD PT, JE to post tomorrow AM after Dana sign-off, re-import and verification within 24 hours.
Dana L.: Adding to month-end exceptions pack and flagging for disclosure if external restatement needed.
Ethan R.: Thanks all. tagging @finance-ops and @eng-billing for visibility :thumbsup:
